definitions.explanation: For things to collect in a heap.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}が{積|つ}もっている。
examples.english: We have a lot to talk about.

notes:
{積|つ}もる is an intransitive godan verb meaning to pile up or accumulate.

TRANSITIVITY:
- {自動詞|じどうし}: {積|つ}もる (to pile up)
- {他動詞|たどうし}: {積|つ}む (to pile, load)

SENSE 1 (physical accumulation):
- {雪|ゆき}が{積|つ}もる: snow piles up
- {埃|ほこり}が{積|つ}もる: dust accumulates
- {落|お}ち{葉|ば}が{積|つ}もる: fallen leaves pile up

SENSE 2 (abstract accumulation):
- {不満|ふまん}が{積|つ}もる: frustration builds up
- {疲|つか}れが{積|つ}もる: fatigue accumulates
- ストレスが{積|つ}もる: stress builds up

IDIOMS:
- {積|つ}もる{話|はなし}: much to talk about ({話|はなし}が{積|つ}もっている)
- {塵|ちり}も{積|つ}もれば{山|やま}となる: many a little makes a mickle (proverb)

RELATED:
- {積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねる: to accumulate (efforts, experience)
- {蓄積|ちくせき}: accumulation (noun)
